title: Close Encounters as a celebration of an accommodation with the grays

tellings.quote: if you in my book Cosmic Whistle Guys discuss was apparently the government's celebration of you know, through Hollywood of an accommodation with the gray aliens.

plain: The 1977 film Close Encounters of the Third Kind was, according to the researcher John Brandenburg, "the government's celebration, through Hollywood, of an accommodation with the gray aliens," the short gray beings of many abduction stories. Brandenburg tells Michels this as an argument from his own book Cosmic Awakening, not from a named source. If true, the government would have struck some kind of deal with aliens and quietly marked it on movie screens.
